criterion_text: : A timed-out or disconnected MCP Kill does not silently retry against a replacement Session; the result/readback preserves the outcome-indeterminate semantics accepted in #3704, with no regression to existing non-MCP legacy consumers.

verifiers.summary: compiled the nession-agent integration test binary for the timeout and abandoned-call proofs

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-agent integration test binary for the timeout and abandoned-call proofs

verifiers.summary: A timed-out MCP kill does not silently retry against a replacement Session

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: an admitted-but-queued MCP kill whose HTTP request timed out reported kind timeout, never started when the lane drained, and left the named real tmux Session alive; only a deliberate readback-then-retry with the current instance killed it

verifiers.summary: A late-started guarded kill refuses a replacement Session instead of retrying against it

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: a queued guarded kill that started after a controlled kill-and-recreate of the same name returned conflict and left the replacement running; it did not reinterpret the later Session as the caller's target

verifiers.summary: compiled the nession-server lib test binary for the kill reply classification

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-server lib test binary for the kill reply classification

verifiers.summary: The Server keeps the guarded refusal typed and outcome-indeterminate and leaves legacy name-only consumers unchanged

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: the guarded kill forwarded its precondition and surfaced the Agent's conflict without removing the Session from the registry; an offline Agent was refused as unavailable; the legacy name-only command carried no precondition and kept its unclassified reply

verifiers.summary: compiled the nession-protocol lib test binary for the refusal classification contract

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: compiled the nession-protocol lib test binary for the refusal classification contract

verifiers.summary: The Protocol declares the guarded kill refusal classification that makes an indeterminate outcome explicit

evidence.value: exact SHA b7e288c9070fb037467705503c7572555f523946: the canonical kill reply carries an optional classified error_kind for guarded refusals while a legacy success or refusal carries none, and the payload keeps the caller's precondition optional
